newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIA RECALL VETERAN ROTARIU TO FACE IRELAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIA RECALL VETERAN ROTARIU TO FACE IRELAND.

text.p: Trainer Anghel Iordanescu on Thursday called up Steaua Bucharest veteran Iosif Rotariu to reinforce a weakened midfield for Romania's World Cup group eight qualifier next week against Ireland.
"Despite his age, Rotariu is in great form and the national team needs him to fortify a weakened midfield line," Iordanescu said.
Rotariu, 36, makes his unexpected comeback next Wednesday in Bucharest after a five-year absence from the national side.

A member of the Steaua squad that won the 1986 European Cup, he was drafted in after Ionut Lupescu of Borussia Monchengladbach refused to play, saying he had spent much of Romania's last outing against Lithuania on the bench.

Another key midfielder, Constantin Galca of Spanish second division team Majorca, is suspended while Barcelona midfielder Gheorghe Popescu is recovering from a foot injury, although Iordanescu said he hoped he would recover in time.
"We need Popescu and doctors are making desperate efforts to put him back in shape," Iordanescu said.
Romania lead group eight with 15 points from five games and a win would make them practically certain of a place in the finals. Ireland are third with seven points from four games.
Macedonia are in second place with 10 points from six matches.
Goalkeepers: Bogdan Stelea (Steaua Bucharest), Dumitru Stingaciu (Kocaelispor, Turkey), Florin Prunea (Dinamo Bucharest);

Defenders: Dan Petrescu (Chelsea), Daniel Prodan (Atletico Madrid), Anton Dobos (AEK Athens), Dumitru Ciobotariu (F.C. National Bucharest), Corneliu Papura (Rennes), Tibor Selymess (Anderlecht Brussels), Cosmin Contra (Dinamo Bucharest);

Midfielders: Gheorghe Hagi (Galatasaray Istanbul), Gheorghe Popescu (Barcelona), Dorinel Munteanu (F.C. Koln), Iulian Filipescu (Galatasaray Istanbul), Iosif Rotariu (Steaua Bucharest), Denis Serban (Steaua Bucharest), Gabi Popescu (Universitatea Craiova);
Forwards: Viorel Moldovan (Grasshoppers Zurich), Adrian Ilie (Galatasaray Istanbul), Ion Vladoiu (F.C. Koln), Gheorghe Craioveanu (Real Sociedad San Sebastian).
